resources.string: Modify the configuration, or save it anyway. Invalid numeric values use safe defaults or limits; saving does not connect the radio.
Select at least one radio device.
The Bluetooth device address is invalid.
TX and RX use the same device. Select single-radio mode or separate devices.
Doppler step must be 10–10000 Hz, in multiples of 10.
Correction step must be 10–1000 Hz, in multiples of 10.
Settle time: 0–10000 ms; linear deadband: 1–10000 Hz; FM deadband: 10–100000 Hz; bus delay: 0–2000 ms.
Preset the radio’s TX/RX mode on the radio. Software does not enable split or satellite mode.
